method: Source inspection and prior evidence verification. No new runtime measurements or security validation.

confirmed.observation: Zero-length records triggers the empty archive claim while initial discovery is loading or has failed. Inspect initial empty snapshot and its error patch against the unconditional list-length branch.
README implies a port fallback on conflict although both combined launchers check exactly one port and stop. The launcher's fail-closed behavior remains the intended policy.
History lists every retained row in reverse retained order and exposes details on explicit selection. It has no label query, backend facet or origin facet.

The current retention note states age eviction and a finite replay ledger. It lacks an eviction history or a per-project remaining ledger meter. The panel receives retained rows rather than an eviction journal.

Rootless history-only projects can transfer history but lack the saved workspace root required for full workspace export. Current two-file distinction is intentional. Support for v1/v2/v3 full and v1 standalone already exists.
Browser/CPU users can read qualified historical native outcomes; live STATIC and INCREMENTAL require current explicit Runtime/native authority. Browser-only usage does not satisfy that requirement.

Workspace recovery preserves original invalid data; unknown/future schemas and missing roots can limit available data. Explicit reattachment and temporary fresh work exist. Automatic salvage is absent.
Assistant continuity is bounded by project-specific current memory and app-wide durable model intent. Browse or import of standalone history does not promote historical text into prompts.

uncertain.observation: Scanning nested result payloads or indexing across projects could increase latency and expose text. No timing baseline was collected.
uncertain.disposition: Proposed contract touches only fixed labels/enums, with O(retained rows), a cap and future native trace.

uncertain.observation: No current native evidence for count announcements or focus fallback after a selected row is removed by filtering.
uncertain.disposition: Measure with keyboard, accessibility tree and a screen reader in future qualification.

uncertain.observation: A future implementation could leak owner-local query state, treat imported metadata as trusted, retarget an action, or send query text to the Assistant. No such future code exists.
User demand for pinning, annotations or comparisons and ideal query dimensions have not been measured.
uncertain.disposition: Freeze the proposed metadata semantics before coding. No claim of user demand measurements.

uncertain.observation: Physical power-loss, true quota exhaustion, long soak and platform eviction/physical backup behavior remain unqualified here.
uncertain.disposition: Keep historical qualification limits. Future injected failures explicitly labeled.
